PROCESS EDITOR

New process

Linear: one step per line. Branch + merge: add IDs and dependencies, e.g. A: Prepare lye [start], B: Prepare oils [start], C: Combine lye and oils [after A,B], D: Blend and pour [after C]. Steps marked [start] run in parallel and join at the dependency step.

Access & Account

Key

Local Data Backup

All Suma Lōra records and settings saved in this browser.

Account & Security

Manage browser-local accounts or sign out of this session. This standalone login is a convenience lock, not server-side authentication.

Mark as paid

Record the payment date and account used.

The expense was paid by someone else. This will create/update the reimbursement obligation; Suma Lōra balance only decreases when reimbursement is recorded.

Record reimbursement

Record the amount reimbursed to the person who paid this expense.

Set opening balances

Enter the starting balances at the point you began tracking in this ERP. These amounts are a baseline, not new income.

Edit current balances

Enter the actual balances currently visible in your bank and Shopee account. ERP will calculate the difference and save it as a dated balance adjustment; existing transactions and opening balances will not be erased.

Only the differences between the ERP balance and the actual balance will be recorded. This keeps an audit trail and avoids changing old transactions.

Transfer between accounts

Transfer moves money between the tracked Bank and Shopee balances; it does not change the combined total.
